about.title: About turgo
about.subtitle: The agent-first classifieds platform built for the Baltic region. We combine AI intelligence with deep local market expertise.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.desc: We're reimagining how people buy and sell online. By combining cutting-edge AI agents with a deep understanding of Baltic markets, we've built a platform where intelligent agents work 24/7 — optimizing pricing, matching buyers with sellers, and streamlining every transaction. Our goal is to make classifieds effortless, fair, and transparent for everyone.

story.title: Our Story
story.p1: turgo was born from a simple frustration: classifieds platforms in the Baltics hadn't evolved in decades. Listings sat unoptimized, pricing was guesswork, and buyers had to manually sift through thousands of posts.
story.p2: We asked ourselves: what if AI agents could handle all of that? What if a selling agent could dynamically price your items, respond to inquiries, and negotiate on your behalf — while a buying agent continuously searched for the best deals matching your criteria?
story.p3: That vision became turgo — the first agent-first classifieds platform purpose-built for Latvia, Lithuania, and Estonia. Today, our AI agents have helped thousands of users across the Baltics buy and sell smarter.

agentFirst.title: Agent-First
agentFirst.desc: AI agents are at the core of everything we build. They work tirelessly so you don't have to.

balticFocus.title: Baltic Focus
balticFocus.desc: We're built for Latvia, Lithuania, and Estonia — with local languages, market data, and cultural nuances.

trustSafety.title: Trust & Safety
trustSafety.desc: AI-powered moderation, verified profiles, and transparent pricing keep the marketplace safe for everyone.

innovation.title: Innovation

q1.q: How do I create a listing?
q1.a: Click the '+ Sell' button in the navigation bar. Our AI selling agent will guide you step-by-step: describe your item, set a price (with AI-suggested pricing), upload photos, and choose your selling strategy. You can also create listings manually if you prefer.

q2.a: turgo's AI agents work behind the scenes to automate buying and selling. Selling agents optimize your listing pricing, auto-respond to buyer inquiries, and can negotiate on your behalf 24/7. Buying agents continuously scan for items matching your criteria and alert you when great deals appear.

q3.q: What regions and languages are supported?
q3.a: turgo covers Latvia, Lithuania, and Estonia. The platform is fully localized in English, Latvian (Latviešu), Lithuanian (Lietuvių), Estonian (Eesti), and Russian (Русский). AI agents can auto-translate listings between languages.

q1.q: How does the AI selling agent price my items?
q1.a: Our pricing engine analyzes comparable listings across Baltic classifieds, factors in item condition, category trends, and market demand to suggest an optimal starting price. Once active, the agent can dynamically adjust pricing based on your urgency setting and buyer interest.

q2.q: Can I control what the selling agent does?
q2.a: Yes! You set the rules. Choose whether the agent can auto-respond to inquiries, enable or disable auto-negotiation, set a minimum acceptable price, and control the urgency level (from 'sell today' to 'no rush'). You can pause or stop the agent at any time.

q3.a: Boosts increase your listing's visibility. 'Highlighted' adds a colored border in search results, 'Featured' places your listing on the homepage, and 'Top Placement' pins it to the top of search results. Pro and Business plans include boost credits.

q1.q: How do I set up a buying agent?
q1.a: Search for what you want, then click 'Create Buying Agent' in the search results. Define your criteria — category, price range, condition, location — and set your maximum budget. The agent will monitor listings 24/7 and notify you of matches.

q2.a: The Deal Score (0–100) rates how good a deal is compared to the market. It considers price vs. market average, time on market, seller urgency, listing quality, and seller reputation. Scores above 75 are considered great deals.

q3.q: Can the buying agent negotiate for me?
q3.a: Yes, if you enable auto-negotiate. Set your target price and maximum offer, and the agent will automatically send offers and counter-offers on your behalf. You'll be notified of any accepted deals.

q1.q: ⏳ Time Escalation — How does it work?
q1.a: Time Escalation is for patient negotiators. Your agent starts bidding at ~70% of your maximum budget and gradually increases on a power curve toward your max as the listing ages. It escalates automatically in 3%+ increments whenever conditions improve. Best for: buyers with flexibility who want to save money but are willing to pay more over time. Requires Pro plan.

q2.q: 💪 Max Bid — How does it differ from Accept Listed Price?
q2.a: Max Bid immediately offers the lower of your maximum budget or the listing price — one shot, no escalation. It’s different from Accept Listed Price because Max Bid uses YOUR budget as the anchor (which may be below listing price), while Accept Listed Price always offers the SELLER’S asking price regardless. If your budget is €500 but the listing is €800, Max Bid offers €500; Accept Listed offers €800. Requires Pro plan.

q3.q: 🎯 Sniper — When should I use it?
q3.a: Sniper waits until the listing is at least 50% through its lifetime, then places a single calculated bid at 85–95% of your budget. It never bids early and never escalates — it’s a single, well-timed strike. Best for: tactical buyers who believe sellers lower expectations as listings age. Requires Business plan.

q4.q: ✅ Accept Listed Price — Is there any negotiation?
q4.a: No negotiation — your agent simply offers the seller’s listed price immediately. However, it uniquely tracks price changes: if the seller raises the price (within your budget), your agent matches the new price. If the price drops, you benefit automatically. Best for: buyers who want a specific item without the risk of losing it to negotiations. Available on all plans including Free.

q5.q: 🐦 Early Bird — How is it different from Time Escalation?
q5.a: Early Bird is the opposite approach. Instead of gradually increasing from your budget, it bids 60–70% of the LISTING PRICE during the first 40% of the listing’s lifetime only. It never escalates or follows up — it’s a take-it-or-leave-it lowball. Time Escalation bids based on your budget over the full lifetime and keeps increasing. Best for: bargain hunters testing seller flexibility on new listings. Available on Free plan.

q1.a: Yes! The Free plan includes up to 5 listings, 1 AI agent, and 5 photos per listing. Upgrade to Pro (€9.99/month) for 50 listings and unlimited agents, or Business (€29.99/month) for unlimited everything plus API access and priority support.

q2.q: How do I manage my subscription?
q2.a: Go to Settings > Data & Privacy or visit the Pricing page. You can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel your plan at any time. Billing is handled securely through Stripe. Yearly subscriptions include a 20% discount.

q3.a: We accept all major credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, Amex) via Stripe. Payments between buyers and sellers are handled directly between parties — turgo facilitates the connection but does not process purchase payments.

q1.a: turgo is fully GDPR-compliant. We encrypt all data in transit and at rest, never sell your personal information, and give you full control over your data. You can export or delete your data at any time from Settings.

q3.q: How do I delete my account?
q3.a: Go to Settings > Data & Privacy and click 'Delete My Account'. You'll need to type 'DELETE' to confirm. This permanently removes all your data, listings, agents, and messages. This action cannot be undone.
